text:
ivy_sales: MerchantOne signing today. They require sustained 5k RPS peak windows, 2x short bursts (~10m), and 200ms p95. Asking for reserved GPU slab + burst-credit pricing. Can eng confirm sizing + recommended autoscale + fallback text for contract?

omar_sre: Clarify traffic shape: single-turn generation? avg seq length?

ivy_sales: Mostly single-turn chat, avg ~360 tokens. Rerank ~5-8% of calls.

lena_prod: With seq~360 and a batching cap to keep queueing <25ms, expect ~800 RPS per A100-eq GPU. For steady 5k RPS recommend 7 reserved GPUs. KV cache warmups can boost effective throughput ~25%.

peter_infra: For 2x bursts add a burst pool of 5 GPUs (spot-backed preferred). Outline two customer options: (A) spot-burst credits + quantized fallback on eviction; (B) premium reserved-burst (higher price) with stricter SLA.

maya_se: Autoscale proposal: monitor 30s RPS avg, scale up when >85% of reserved for 60s, cooldown 120s. Allow burst pool to absorb up to configured max. If burst capacity not provisioned within 120s, auto-fallback to quantized-8bit variant; continued constraint -> 429s for excess requests. Notify customer via webhook.

omar_sre: Draft SLA blurb for MSA: "Reserved capacity is guaranteed per schedule. Burst credits are best-effort; if burst capacity cannot be provisioned within 120 seconds, Redwood will attempt an automated fallback to a quantized model variant. If capacity remains constrained, excess requests may receive HTTP 429 responses; credits and remedies are described in the contract."

lena_prod: Add runbook: 1) detect surge -> check KV hit-rate; 2) if KV cold -> kick preheat (recommended 10m before campaign); 3) if preheat fails or eviction occurs -> route to quantized fallback; 4) notify oncall + customer webhook.

peter_infra: Preheat example: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.example/v1/preheat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"job":"kv_warm","model":"merchant-chat-v1","start_in":"10m","duration_mins":15}'`

maya_se: Security checklist: CMEK/KMS supported, VPC peering available, audit logs exportable to customer S3, SOC2 addendum needed (~5 business days legal review). No technical blockers.

ivy_sales: Obs asks from MerchantOne: per-route latency percentiles, token-level cost export, and a dedicated dashboard. Can we deliver?

lena_prod: Yes — we'll create a tenant dashboard with p50/p95/p99, token-cost CSV export, KV hit rate, and coldstart rate. Alert: p95 > 200ms for two consecutive 5-min windows -> page oncall.

ivy_sales: Action items: @lena_prod perf table + conservative GPU counts; @peter_infra runbook + preheat snippet; @maya_se security checklist + SOC2 ETA; @omar_sre finalize SLA paragraph. I'll package for legal & finance.
